request.description:
Lista de achievements.

Opciones de query:
- populate: nombres de relaciones y medios (ej: image, user_achievements) o '*'
- pagination[page], pagination[pageSize]
- sort: campo:orden (ej: createdAt:desc)
- filters: ej. filters[rewardType][$eq]=coins, filters[isActive][$eq]=true
- publicationState: live | preview (draft/publish activo)

Enums:
- targetType: gamesWon | dailyLogin | xp | score | time
- rewardType: coins | tickets
